verdict.rationale: First-party docs show developers can build custom Actors with the Apify SDK toolkits and the `apify create` CLI command. They can write them in Python or JavaScript with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy or Crawlee, and package them on Apify-maintained Docker base images. Once on the platform, Actors run, schedule, monitor and scale without self-managed infrastructure, and existing projects can be migrated in. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deploy/push step to the cloud, an explicit statement of serverless or no-infrastructure execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of building and deploying custom Actors (community comments are generic praise of the product and SDK).
